{{Quote|Gemthrop City &mdash; it's been a long time since I've been here. Those walls are for protection from the wild herds of Lecknag Beasts. Be careful; let me do the talking down there. They don't like Humans.|Jiuk'chtna|<ref name="RPG2" />}}
'''Jiuk'chtna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]]. Some time during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he hired a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to take him to [[Gemthrop City]]. He warned the spacer to be careful, as the residents of Gemthrop City did not like Humans.
